label: Version 1.4
releaseNotes: Adds expandable help throughout the main workflow so each step is easier to understand when guidance is needed.
Shows clear live previews as choices change, making it easier to confirm Referral Numbers, ICNs, Station values, and filenames before creating files.
Makes Referral Number setup clearer with VA, iFAMS, VAiFAMS, and flexible Custom choices.
Keeps generated Referral Numbers and ICNs unique automatically, including larger batches and longer values.
Makes Station selection more reliable and keeps approved Station values exactly as selected.
Adds faster searchable selection for SEOC and Situational SEOC values, including one, several, or all available choices.
Shows clean SEOC names without extra numbers while keeping every selection correctly paired.
Places regular and Situational SEOC choices together on wider screens and keeps them easy to use on smaller windows.
Makes Archive naming easier with ready-made choices or a Custom checkbox builder, plus an immediate filename preview.
Uses the same compact, professional choice-card design throughout the app in both light and dark themes.
Makes keeping or replacing existing output files easier to understand before a run begins.
Explains the difference between Referral and LEIE output, including which upload destinations are available, and remembers user choices after the app restarts.
